metadata.description: High-signal individual voices on social platforms
metadata.note: These are people, not publications - following individual thinkers rather than editorial boards

high_signal_accounts.name: Andrej Karpathy
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Ex-OpenAI, Tesla. Best educator in AI. Clear technical explanations without hype.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Thread reader often needed for long-form thoughts

high_signal_accounts.name: Simon Willison
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Deep practical knowledge, excellent at explaining complex topics simply
high_signal_accounts.notes: Also has excellent blog at simonwillison.net

high_signal_accounts.name: Yann LeCun
high_signal_accounts.focus: AI research, Meta AI, deep learning
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Meta Chief Scientist. Research perspective, often contrarian to hype
high_signal_accounts.notes: Can be argumentative but signals are high

high_signal_accounts.name: Jeremy Howard
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: fast.ai founder. Makes ML accessible, focuses on practical application
high_signal_accounts.notes: Often shares notebooks and working code

high_signal_accounts.name: Dan Luu
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Extremely rigorous analysis of systems performance. Data-driven contrarian takes.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Blog posts are deep dives; tweets are signals worth tracking

high_signal_accounts.name: Patrick McKenzie
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Unique perspective on intersection of tech and business. Long-form tweet threads.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Works at Stripe; insights on financial infrastructure

high_signal_accounts.name: Jessie Frazelle
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Deep systems knowledge, early Docker contributor, practical insights
high_signal_accounts.notes: Now at Oxide Computer; hardware + software perspective

high_signal_accounts.name: John Carmack
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Legendary engineer. Still coding daily. Unique insights on AGI from ML research.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Now full-time AGI research; shares research process openly

high_signal_accounts.name: Ethan Mollick
high_signal_accounts.focus: AI in education, workplace, practical adoption
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Wharton professor studying AI adoption. Data-driven insights on how people actually use AI.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Runs largest real-world study of AI workplace usage

high_signal_accounts.name: Demis Hassabis
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: CEO DeepMind. Major breakthrough announcements (AlphaGo, AlphaFold) come through here first.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Lower volume but each post is significant

high_signal_accounts.name: Noam Brown
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: OpenAI researcher. Led Superhuman AI in Diplomacy. Excellent thread explanations.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Explains complex research in accessible threads

high_signal_accounts.name: Aravind Srinivas
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: CEO Perplexity. Shares product decisions and AI search trends.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Good signal on AI-native product development

high_signal_accounts.name: Riley Goodside
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Pioneer in prompt engineering. Discovers LLM capabilities through clever experiments.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Now at Scale AI; consistently finds surprising LLM behaviors

high_signal_accounts.name: Shreya Shankar
high_signal_accounts.focus: ML systems, data engineering, production ML
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: PhD researcher focusing on ML in production. Excellent on data quality and pipelines.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Blog: shreya-shankar.com - writes about real ML systems challenges

high_signal_accounts.name: Aidan Clark
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: OpenAI researcher working on scaling and capabilities. Shares research insights.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Good for understanding current frontier model development

high_signal_accounts.name: Paul Christiano
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Alignment researcher, founded ARC Evals. Deep thinking on AI risk and safety.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Long-form blog posts; tweets often link to deeper content

high_signal_accounts.name: Amber Ace
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Tracks AI policy developments globally. Good signal on regulatory trends.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Focus on EU AI Act, US executive orders, international coordination

high_signal_accounts.name: Jan Leike
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Former OpenAI superalignment lead. Shares technical safety research and concerns.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Left OpenAI May 2024; important perspective on safety culture

high_signal_accounts.name: Chip Huyen
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Author of Designing ML Systems. Practical, comprehensive technical content.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Newsletter and book recommendations are high quality

high_signal_accounts.name: Sebastian Raschka
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Author of Machine Learning with PyTorch. Excellent explainer threads and code examples.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Very active, consistently shares working code and tutorials

high_signal_accounts.name: Sasha Rush
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Professor at Cornell Tech. Works on efficient transformers and NLP systems.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Good balance of research and practical implementation

high_signal_accounts.name: Gergely Orosz
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: The Pragmatic Engineer. Deep dives into tech companies and engineering culture.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Excellent on AI industry moves and engineering team dynamics

selection_criteria: Shares working code/artifacts, not just opinions

category_definitions.ai_research: Academic researchers, lab leads, published scientists at frontier labs
category_definitions.ai_industry: Startup founders, product leaders, tech executives in AI companies
category_definitions.ai_engineering: Practitioners building AI systems, ML engineers, tool builders
category_definitions.ai_safety: Alignment researchers, safety evaluators, risk-focused researchers
category_definitions.ai_policy: Governance experts, regulatory trackers, policy researchers

integration_notes.workaround: Use Nitter RSS feeds with fallback to manual curation
integration_notes.priority: Medium - these are highest signal but hardest to automate
integration_notes.alternative: Monitor their blogs when available (many have newsletters/blogs)
integration_notes.usage: Cross-reference with sources-ai.json for blog/newsletter duplicates
